run_f_gold: run f_gold to reverse the order of words in a given string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input strings to verify word reversal correctness
review_f_gold: review f_gold which iterates backward through a string to reverse word order
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python string split and reverse instead of manual iteration
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which reverses words in a string by scanning from end to start
